description: T2.1: Decompose ChartViewModel (1388 LOC, 17+ deps, 44 functions) into focused controller classes using composition. Extract: ChartDataController (market data loading, symbol/timeframe switching, candle management, prepend history), ChartIndicatorCoordinator (indicator computation, SMC detection, market structure analysis, incremental compute), ChartAiCoordinator (AI agent orchestration, decision engine, MTF context, explanation), ChartMultiChartController (multi-chart panel management, crosshair sync, persistence), ChartDrawingController (drawing tools, drawing persistence), and slim ChartViewModel orchestrating these.
steps: Create app/src/main/java/com/foxtrader/app/feature/chart/presentation/ChartDataController.kt: Extract observeMarket(), observeWebSocketTicks(), processMergedCandles(), rebuildMergedVisibleCandles(), loadOlderHistory(), refresh(), onSymbolChange(), onTimeframeChange(), resetPrimaryChartContext(), clearPrependedHistory(), connectLive(), disconnectLive(), toggleLive() and related state (symbolFlow, timeframeFlow, currentObservedCandles, prependedHistory*, mergedVisibleCandles, HISTORY_PAGE_SIZE). Class takes MarketRepository, MarketWebSocket, CoroutineDispatcher as dependencies. Expose flows/callbacks for the ViewModel to wire.

Create app/src/main/java/com/foxtrader/app/feature/chart/presentation/ChartIndicatorCoordinator.kt: Extract processCandles(), computeFrame(), computeFullFrame(), computeIncrementalFrame(), mergeOverlayWindow() and the shift extension functions. Takes AnalyzeMarketStructureUseCase, ComputeIndicatorsUseCase, MarketExplanationEngine, CoroutineDispatcher. Holds lastProcessedSnapshot, INCREMENTAL_ANALYSIS_WINDOW. Returns ChartComputation results.

Create app/src/main/java/com/foxtrader/app/feature/chart/presentation/ChartAiCoordinator.kt: Extract runAiDecision() and the AI-related state (lastAiCandlesHash). Takes AgentOrchestrator, MasterDecisionEngine, MtfContextProvider, MarketExplanationEngine, ConfluenceEngine, AiAlertService, AlertDispatcher, CoroutineDispatcher. Returns decision results to the ViewModel.

Create app/src/main/java/com/foxtrader/app/feature/chart/presentation/ChartMultiChartController.kt: Extract ALL multi-chart functions (add/remove/move/set/toggle panels, sync, crosshair sync, persistence, restore, ensureMultiChartPanelCount, syncMultiChartPanelsToPrimary, refreshMultiChartPanels, publishMultiChartState, linkedPanelTimeframes, targetPanelContext, etc.). Takes MultiChartManager, MarketRepository, AnalyzeMarketStructureUseCase, AppPreferences, CoroutineDispatcher. Manages _multiChartState, all panel jobs/states/fingerprints/viewportStates.

Create app/src/main/java/com/foxtrader/app/feature/chart/presentation/ChartDrawingController.kt: Extract startDrawing(), placeDrawingPoint(), cancelDrawing(), clearAllDrawings(), toggleDrawingToolbar(). Takes DrawingEngine, DrawingRepository.

Rewrite ChartViewModel.kt to be a slim orchestrator (~200-300 lines) that: instantiates the controllers via constructor injection (no @Inject on controllers themselves - they are internal to the chart feature), delegates all public functions to the appropriate controller, and wires the controllers' outputs into the single _uiState StateFlow. Keep @HiltViewModel annotation, keep all existing public API signatures unchanged so ChartScreen.kt does not need changes.

Add unit tests for ChartIndicatorCoordinator and ChartAiCoordinator in app/src/test/java/com/foxtrader/app/feature/chart/presentation/ to validate the incremental compute path and AI fingerprint skip logic
